items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1969-05-30
items.q: Remember Johnny Benson? Benson played harmonica all around.

ctx.x: About stuff like stuff I haven't met him.
If that's the same fellow, you know who I think that is, Alan? Listening to their voice. Remember Johnny Benson? Benson played harmonica all around.
